mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies and a temperature of 65 degrees out by the Military Ridge State Trail under a New Moon.

In city news, police were called to the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way on September 10th for a burglary. A 19-year-old suspect from Madison was arrested and will face charges for burglary and recklessly endangering safety after a firearm was discharged during the event.

There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmers Market taking place today, followed by live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the city welcomes the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival on Main Street.

Regarding the incident on September 10th, Verona officers arrived at a scene on Hunters Cove Way where a suspect was taken into custody after a burglary attempt involving a firearm, with no resulting injuries reported.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew, which you can look forward to enjoying when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
